description:

Please **join this group** and **reserve** your seat every week.

title: AKL Multi-Model Copilot, Autonomous Agents & Token ROI
description:
Join us for an exclusive evening with visiting GitHub Engineers **Marco Celon** and **Amanda Tan** as we explore the next evolution of AI-assisted software development. Beyond traditional code completion, modern developer workflows now demand seamless orchestration across multiple surfaces, diverse AI models, and autonomous agents—all while keeping enterprise token budgets under control.

Whether you are looking to supercharge your personal developer flow or scale AI productivity across an entire organization, this session delivers actionable strategies straight from the team building these tools.
What We'll Cover:

* **Multi-Surface & Multi-Model Integration:** Learn how to route developer workflows across IDEs, CLI tools, and cloud agents while leveraging diverse models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) tailored to task complexity.
* **Token ROI & Cost Control:** Master practical techniques for context window optimization, prompt hygiene, and enterprise budget caps to keep token consumption efficient and cost-effective.

**Agenda**
5:30 - Pizza and networking
6:00 - Talks
7:00 - Finish

title: The Broken Circle Breakdown (Belgium 2012) 1 hr 50
description:
It is time for a rom-com weepy but with a punch. This film was nominated for the Academy Awards for the Best Foreign Language - and made the shortlist. A young couple's relationship is tested when their daughter develops a serious illness. This film is also a musical (bluegrass) which is something of a first for us!

However, this is no weepie rom-com soap. It takes us to the heart of a relationship under strain. The New Zealand Herald reviewer wrote:

"Heldenbergh and Baetens [the two leads] do mesmerising work on Van Groeningen's script, in which not a word or a glance is wasted. Time after time the camera takes us in really close and they never blink. The opening 10 minutes, a sustained display of astonishing virtuosity, makes us feel like we have known these two for years. But the film's cut takes us deeper still, cleverly merging past and present (we don't see the couple meet until the mid-point) in a way that freights the smallest moment with heavy dramatic irony."
